arStrings.szText: {c_important}Wolves{/c} deal {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage to Immobilized, Stunned, Slowed, or Poisoned enemies.

{c_important}Wolves{/c} is also a {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skill.

Your {c_important}Wolf{/c} Companions are now {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Companions and deal {c_number}[SF_30*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Companions will use {c_important}Feral Dash{/c} on their own against Distant enemies but does not make them {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c}.
Commanding your {c_important}Wolves{/c} grants you {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}[SF_32]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Wolves'{/c} instantly break out of any Crowd Control effects, becoming enraged and gaining {c_number}[SF_11*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage for {c_number}[SF_12]{/c} seconds afterward.
Enemies hit by {c_important}Feral Dash{/c} are Stunned for {c_number}[SF_31|1|]{/c} seconds.
When your {c_important}Wolves{/c} Critically Strike, you gain {c_number}[SF_28*100|%|]{/c} Attack Speed for {c_number}[SF_29]{/c} seconds.
